collection.description: A child challenges an elder's explanation of why everyone must follow a harmless old custom.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) challenges (elder)'s explanation of why everyone must follow a harmless old custom.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (elder) reveals the custom once solved a practical problem.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (elder) admits the original reason has been forgotten.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) suggests a small change that the family enjoys.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (elder) prefers the old practice, and (child) accepts the difference.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) decides to revisit the question when older.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) discovers that neighbors do things differently.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) learns that variation does not make a family wrong.
